0022600110.text: The Pelicans (0-2, 10th in the West) are on a two-game losing streak and sit 4th in the Southwest, 2 games back, as they visit the Denver Nuggets (0-1, 11th in the West), who are 5th in the Northwest, 1.5 games back. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Denver won all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently 122-116 in New Orleans on January 13, 2026. New Orleans is without Yves Missi (day-to-day, knee, game-time decision), while Denver is without Cameron Johnson (out, ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (out, hamstring), and Alpha Diallo is day-to-day with a wrist injury and is a game-time decision.
